overall_goal: Portion the potato and chicken mixture and roll it into smooth balls.

goals.description: Scoop and adjust the potato chicken mixture to the desired quantity.
goals.rationale: The person takes the mixture and reduces its quantity to get the right amount for a single ball.

goals.description: Mold the first portion of mixture into a ball and coat it with flour.
goals.rationale: The person shapes the mixture into a ball and sprinkles flour over it to make it smooth and prevent sticking.

goals.description: Mold the second portion of mixture into a ball and coat it with flour.
goals.rationale: The person shapes another ball of the mixture, sprinkles it with flour, and reshapes it.

goals.description: Mold the third portion of mixture into a ball and coat it with flour.
goals.rationale: The person sprinkles flour over a new portion of the mixture and molds it into a ball.

goals.description: Mold the fourth portion of mixture into a ball and coat it with flour.
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly sprinkles flour over the mixture and rolls it into a spherical form.
